prompt: This lecture excerpt runs about three and a half minutes and I need it closer to two and a half for a class module. Tighten it up: take out the pauses and anything that doesn't move the explanation forward, but keep the explanation complete and don't cut her off mid-sentence.

checklist.description: The programme lands around two and a half minutes (140-170 s)
No black holes between kept segments
Each kept segment keeps its own sound
Still covers what a memory is, the hippocampus, the cortex and the map example, in order
No sentence is cut off mid-way and no word is clipped
Cuts inside one shot don't jump awkwardly
